leo: Heads up — RC blocked. JS SDK regen produced a typegen diff that failed sample-app onboarding CI. Anyone on call?
nina: Link?
leo: https://ci.internal/17555 job 7
leo: Error snippet:
```
Type-hash mismatch
- export interface WidgetPayload { title: string; attrs?: Record<string, any>; }
+ export interface WidgetPayload { attrs?: Record<string, any>; title: string; }
```
nina: Property ordering changed in generator; causes type-hash bump. Two routes: force deterministic sort in generator or accept new type-hash and bump packages.
leo: Semver guard already rejected the release because CHANGELOG labels this as "feature". This is purely SDK parity — we need a patch.
dx-bot: Suggestion: open a small PR that sets `generator.stableSort=true`, regen types, update package metadata (type-hash), and amend CHANGELOG line to "patch(sdk): regen parity". Mark PR with `release:regen-fix` label.
leo: Agreed. I'll run `yarn tools:typegen --stableSort` locally and smoke the sample-app before pushing. Nina, can you review changelog wording quickly?
nina: Yep, will review. If CI still flakes we can ask release-ops for a one-time exemption and add a follow-up ticket to audit generator versions across SDKs.
ci-bot: build queued for leo/regen-fix (job 7).
leo: PR incoming in ~8m. Will include before/after diff and exact commands run. :thumbsup:
